title: Vintage 1976 The Crusaders Vol. 14 "THE GODFATHERS" by J.T.C. Comic Book
descriptionText:
Up for sale is a vintage 1976 comic book titled "The Crusaders Vol. 14" featuring "The Godfathers" story by J.T.C. This single issue comic book is a great addition to any collection and perfect for fans of US Comics tradition. The comic book was published by Crusade Comics in the United States and has a publication date of 1976.

The comic book features the character T.C. and is part of the "The Crusaders" series title. It falls under the Collectibles, Comic Books & Memorabilia, Comics, and Comics & Graphic Novels categories. Get your hands on this classic piece of comic book history and add it to your collection today!
